events.name: Mvp Court Pass (check In By 6:30pm)
events.info: THIS IS AN OPTIONAL UPGRADE. TICKET TO THE MAIN EVENT IS ALSO REQUIRED. Get closer than courtside with the MVP Court Pass! Join the Pre-Game Fan Tunnel to welcome the Harlem Globetrotters to the floor, step into the Pre-Game Huddle, warm up with the team, and watch the famous Globetrotters Magic Circle from just feet away. This is MVP access on another level, and the perfect way to make a memory you'll talk about for years to come. With just 16 passes per game, this is the most exclusive 20 minutes in the arena. Check in at the announcer's table 30 mins prior to the game start. Late arrivals will not be refunded. All participants must have their own MVP Court Pass-no exceptions. Children under 10 must be with an adult who also has an MVP Court Pass. Soft or rubber-soled shoes required. This premium upgrade is not included with your game ticket. Don't miss your chance to be part of the Rivalry as an MVP!

events.name: Limited Edition Rivals Replica Game Ball From Spalding®
events.info: THIS IS AN OPTIONAL UPGRADE. TICKET TO THE MAIN EVENT IS ALSO REQUIRED. How to Redeem Your Limited Edition Rivals Replica Game ball from Spaulding. Limited Edition Rivals Replica Game Ball from Spalding. Half Harlem Globetrotters, half Washington Generals, commemorating 75 years of the rivalry that started it all. To pick up your exclusive game ball, visit the Harlem Globetrotters Merchandise Stand located inside the venue on game day. Pick-up is only available during pre-game, half-time, or post-game. Ball MUST be picked up at the venue on the date of your ticketed event. No alternate pick-up dates, locations, nor shipping options are available. This purchase is NON TRANSFERABLE.

events.name: Ultimate Fan Pass: 30-min Exclusive On-court Access From 5:30-6:00pm
events.info: TICKET TO MAIN EVENT ALSO REQUIRED Get closer to the action with the all-new Ultimate Fan Pass- a limited-capacity, 30-minute pregame on-court experience featuring the Harlem Globetrotters and their Rivals. Be first through the doors and first on the court, where you get exclusive access up close with the players, learn trick shots from the pros, get one-of-a-kind photos, and kick off your own tip-off party before the rest of the crowd arrives. Ultimate Fan Pass guests also get first access to the merchandise stands before the lines form. A separate game ticket is required and is not included with this experience. Minors must be accompanied by an adult who also holds an Ultimate Fan Pass. Soft-or rubber-soled shoes are required on court. The on-court experience begins 90 minutes before game time. Late arrivals may miss some of all of the experience and are not eligible for refunds.

presales.description: To access the sale, use the first 6 digits of your eligible Citi® credit card or Citibank Debit Card as your presale code. You will also need to use your Citi® card to successfully complete your purchase.

events.info: Have the Harlem Globetrotters finally met their match? The Washington General brand new lineup of rivals step onto the court-hungry for a win, and out to prove it! The Harlem Globetrotters-the team that invented basketball culture- bring the Rivalry Tour to your city as part of their 2027 world tour, with a roster of stars who turn every possession into showtime, quarter after quarter. This is a new experience-you're not just watching, you're part of it. You could get pulled onto the court. Join he squad. Own the jumbotron...Because anything can happen at a Globetrotters game. A free, all-new pre-game party kicks off the moment doors open, packed with new surprises for longtime fans and first-time families. This is Globetrotters job-electric, and built for YOU! The rivalry is theirs. The thrill is yours. Get your tickets now.
events.pleaseNote: A warning to any fans with light sensitivity that strobing effects will be used during light shows within the Harlem Globetrotters game. By purchasing this ticket, you give permission to use your likeness

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Our box office is open on all show days starting two (2) hours prior to the scheduled door time. To purchase tickets online, please visit www.archermusichall.com. If you're looking to obtain a refund for a show that was either canceled or rescheduled, visit www.livenation.com/refund for more information. We look forward to seeing you at one of our upcoming shows!
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Archer Music Hall is a cashless venue. At the box office we accept cash and all major credit cards including VISA, Mastercard, Amex, & Discover. Apple Pay & Google Pay are also accepted.

venues.parkingDetail: Q: Where is Premier Parking? A: Guests with Premier Parking have access to the 940 Linden Deck at 940 Linden St, Allentown, 18101, starting two hours before their event door time.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Archer Music Hall strives to make our venue and live experiences inclusive and accessible to everyone. For all information about accessibility at our venue, including: arrival & accessible entrances, accessible restrooms, ticketing, accessible parking, medication & dietary needs, service animals , sign language interpretation, assistive listening devices, & mobility device storage - please visit archermusichall.com/accessibility. For more questions, please contact us at ArcherInfo@livenation.com or call (610) 798-1473.

generalInfo.generalRule: For more information on our venue policies and FAQ, please visit our website www.archermusichall.com/visit.
generalInfo.childRule: All patrons must have a ticket regardless of age. Some shows may be restricted to certain ages. Please check our website archermusichall.com or call (610) 798-1473 for updated information.

events.info: Get ready for the ultimate family day out! With awesome trucks, amazing stunts and action-packed excitement, Monster jam is the definition of fun for everyone! You'll be close to the action watching the world's best drivers tear up the dirt and show off crazy skills and all-out racing in fierce head-to-head battles of speed and skill. See the world's most popular trucks like Grave Differ, El Toro Loco, Sparkle Smash and more only at Monster Jam. Be loud, cheer hard and watch these Monster Jam trucks do the impossible. It's too fun to miss!
events.pleaseNote: -All guests age 2 & older are required to have a ticket. -No costumes for guests 14 & older. -Please monitor the venue website for venue policies, including health and safety protocols, which are subject to change. -All tickets are subject to availability. -Prices & Competitors are subject to change. -Monster Jam Trackside begins approximately one hour before the event start time and features: - Competition Preview - Driver Interviews - Behind the Scenes with the Pit Crew - Judges Zone Overview - Opening Ceremonies - Giveaways - Power Rush Truck Introductions There's no better way to get ready for the action, so get to your seats early to experience all the family fun. -Visit MonsterJam.com for more event info and Ticket Terms and Conditions.
